intent: 一句话业务/变更意图（中文）
scope: 变更文件/分组/符号摘要（中文）

risk_tier.drivers: Short summary of path/tag/sensitive/rollout drivers — or None

design_fit.risk: REQUIRED when concern/unknown: plain-language specific code risk in this repo — or omit when ok
design_fit.belong_in_repo: (legacy flat) yes | questionable | unknown — cite path/package clusters
design_fit.layer_fit: (legacy flat) Short note from layer_summary / import_cross_layer / cross_layer_edges
design_fit.over_engineering: (legacy flat) None, or add-heavy / dead_nested / empty edges-in
design_fit.timing_note: (legacy flat) Optional; do not invent product strategy

complexity.risk: REQUIRED when concern: plain-language specific code risk (path + what breaks)

call_chain.title: Optional HTML call-path for this dimension risk

complexity.hotspots: Same prose as risk (or detail bullets) — renderer uses risk // hotspots. Soft LOC parenthetical OK; no loc_high+untested dump.
complexity.yagni: Plain note if implementation is more generic than needed — or None
complexity.evidence: One plain sentence of basis, optional (信号: 11-complexity-signals.json)

dependencies.risk: REQUIRED when concern: which dependency/lock/license risk and impact
dependencies.reproducibility: SNAPSHOT / floating / lock drift notes — or None
dependencies.license: Manifest license clues only (not legal advice) — or None
dependencies.vuln_posture: Local audit summary or residual: run org SCA — never invent CVEs

resilience.risk: REQUIRED when concern: which failure-path risk and user/runtime impact
resilience.silent_swallow: Empty/bare catch or ignored err — or None
resilience.timeouts: Remote/IO without timeout/deadline clues — or None
resilience.degradation: Fallback / circuit-breaker clues or residual — or None
resilience.partial_failure: Fan-out without per-item / allSettled handling — or None
resilience.idempotency: Retry/MQ/pay without idempotent/compensate clues — or None

privacy.risk: REQUIRED when concern: which PII/log/retention risk
privacy.minimization: PII field bloat / purpose clues — or None
privacy.logging: Log redaction / plaintext PII — or None
privacy.consent_transfer: Consent / cross-border / third-party clues — or None

rollout.risk: REQUIRED when concern: which migration/flag/rollback risk for release
rollout.dual_write: Dual-write / expand-contract / backfill gaps — or None
rollout.feature_flags: Flag/toggle/kill-switch clues or gaps — or None
rollout.compat_window: Deprecate/breaking without sunset/compat clues — or None
rollout.breaking_announce: Breaking without CHANGELOG/migration guide — or None
rollout.rollback: Rollback/canary/blue-green clues or gaps — or None

performance.risk: REQUIRED when concern: which hot-path / N+1 / alloc risk and user impact
performance.n_plus_one: Loop-hosted DB/ORM/HTTP without batch — or None
performance.unbounded_allocation: Loop alloc / unpaginated list / unbounded cache — or None

llm_judgment.risk: REQUIRED when concern: plain-language summary of novel LLM-only issues after dedupe
llm_judgment.risk_en: English mirror of risk when concern
llm_judgment.focus_files: Bounded files/symbols the agent LLM read — or None
llm_judgment.evidence: 22-llm-judgment.json + host-agent LLM pass (merged vs heuristic findings)

p1.title: 发现标题（中文）
p1.change_status: add|change|default — HTML maps to 本次新增/本次修改/既有代码…
p1.category: design | complexity | dependencies | correctness | resilience | security | privacy | contract | rollout | concurrency | regression | test_gaps | observability | maintainability | performance | risk_tier | llm_judgment | …
p1.source: optional — set "llm_judgment" for novel host-agent LLM findings (after dedupe)
p1.risk: 触发路径与影响（中文白话）
p1.risk_en: Trigger path and impact in plain English

call_chain.title: 可选 — 调用链路标题（中文）

p1.evidence_en: Human basis first (English); artifact path optional appendix
p1.entry: from tags/paths when present; else omit — do not invent
p1.entry_en: English mirror when entry is prose
p1.confidence: (JSON audit only — omitted from HTML) high|medium|low|UNKNOWN

regression_tests.target: 可执行回归场景：谁在什么条件下调用、输入是什么、期望什么结果（勿只写方法名）
regression_tests.why: 为什么必测：用业务/风险语言说明漏测后果
regression_tests.why_en: Why required: business/risk consequence if untested
regression_tests.evidence: 通俗依据：改了哪个类/方法的什么行为、受影响的调用方类型。禁止仅写证据包路径、行号标签或裸 symbol UUID；内部 id 仅可作句末附录
regression_tests.evidence_en: Plain-language basis; do not use only pack paths or bare symbol UUIDs

test_gaps.note: 风险说明（中文）；勿编造覆盖
test_gaps.note_en: Risk note (English); do not invent coverage

sensitive: 无，或与变更相交的敏感命中（中文）
sensitive_en: None, or hits intersecting change with callers (English)
fix_order: (optional JSON only — not rendered in HTML)
residual_risks: (optional JSON only — not rendered in HTML)

diagrams.title: (Deprecated for HTML) Prefer call_chain on findings / dimension cards — standalone 影响面示意 is no longer rendered
diagrams.body: optional legacy mermaid; ignored by render-review-html.sh
